items.title: Dashboard gains Anonymity, Storage, and a live update list
items.body: The Command Deck now shows whether you are exiting through Tor (and how to turn it off), every drive with used/total space plus any unmounted disk, and the Update panel lists exactly which packages will update, by source.

items.title: Turn interfaces on/off and manage Wi-Fi from the Network panel
items.body: Each interface has a Turn on/off control (with a guard before disabling your primary link), and a Wi-Fi section for radio on/off, scanning, and connecting appears when a wireless device is present.

items.title: Run any app inside a Tor-only namespace
items.body: From the Privacy panel you can launch any app confined to a Tor-only network namespace, as your user, with the real interface unreachable to it. It starts Tor first if needed, showing the live bootstrap loader.

items.title: i2p overlay hardened and leak-tested; hostname and DNS fixes
items.body: The optional i2p overlay was stress-tested for leaks alongside Tor, the hostname spoof now holds for the whole session, and stopping always restores working DNS.

items.title: arx is now pure Rust
items.body: The package manager was rebuilt on libalpm in-process for near-instant queries, with a supply-chain verify gate so components are checked before they install.
